title: Kissinger-Dobrynin transcript on microwave beams at Moscow embassy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kissinger-Dobrynin transcript on microwave beams at Moscow embassy, about 1970s at US Embassy, Moscow, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
you have this recently
Declassified document around the salt to

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a recently declassified transcript from the 1970s talks between the US and the Soviet Union on limiting nuclear arms and easing tensions. According to Michels, in it Henry Kissinger, the Soviet ambassador Anatoly Dobrynin and the American diplomat Walter Stoessel discuss microwave beams aimed at the US embassy in Moscow. He raises it because it would show that secret energy-beam matters were handled at the highest levels of government.
